'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Gaza war]]
**[[Gaza peace plan]]
***[[Hamas]] hands over the 20 remaining living [[Gaza war hostage crisis|Israeli hostages]] to the [[ICRC|Red Cross]], and Israel releases over 1,900 [[Palestinians|Palestinian]] [[Palestinians in Israeli custody|detainees]], including 250 people serving life sentences for convictions in attacks on Israelis, as part of the ceasefire agreement. [https://apnews.com/article/gaza-israel-hamas-hostages-ceasefire-10-13-2025-9e4921406e846189c90144609c1a9530  (AP)]
***Under the terms of the ceasefire agreement, local authorities shut down aid distribution sites run by the [[Gaza Humanitarian Foundation]], which were the locations of [[2025 Gaza Strip aid distribution killings|shootings]] by the [[Israeli military]] that killed over 2,600 people seeking food aid. [https://apnews.com/article/gaza-aid-group-us-israel-ceasefire-dec2aa4e5d33f58eca34bf21603176bc (AP)]
***Hamas returns the bodies of four of the 28 deceased [[Gaza war hostage crisis|Israeli hostages]], partially violating a provision of the ceasefire agreement for all hostages to be returned in one day, though the agreement acknowledged the possible inability of Hamas to be able to locate all the bodies in the specified timeframe. [https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/c740jx07vz0o (BBC)] [https://www.haaretz.com/israel-news/2025-10-13/ty-article/.premium/hamas-to-return-bodies-of-four-hostages-breaking-agreement-to-return-all-on-same-day/00000199-ddc1-d253-a3bd-ffcbe9d50000 (Haaretz)]
**Hamas [[Public execution|publicly executes]] eight men in [[Gaza City]] accused of being criminals and Israeli collaborators. [https://www.reuters.com/world/middle-east/hamas-fighters-tighten-grip-gaza-clouding-future-ceasefire-2025-10-14/ (Reuters)] [https://www.bbc.com/news/live/cx2r2z0gyp7t?post=asset%3Af7d58e0a-abd1-4213-9f97-02a6427cc571#post (BBC)]
*[[Afghanistan–Pakistan clashes (2024–present)|Afghanistan–Pakistan clashes]]
**[[2025 Afghanistan–Pakistan conflict]]
***Nineteen [[Afghan Army|security forces]] are killed in two [[Pakistan]]i [[airstrike]]s in [[Spin Boldak]] and [[Bahramcha]], [[Afghanistan]]. A local high-ranking commander is among the fatalities. [https://kabulnow.com/2025/10/at-least-19-taliban-fighters-killed-in-pakistani-drone-strikes-in-southern-afghanistan/ (Kabul Now)]
*[[2025 Malagasy protests]]
**[[2025 Malagasy coup d'état]]
***[[Madagascar|Malagasy]] [[President of Madagascar|president]] [[Andry Rajoelina]] flees the country after losing the support of the [[Madagascar Armed Forces|armed forces]] following weeks of [[Gen Z protests|Gen Z]]-led protests against him. Rajoelina says he has not resigned and confirms a [[coup d'état]] is underway. [https://apnews.com/article/madagascar-coup-rajoelina-soldiers-military-africa-b17e7f78a6b0d4abf82a4a19a7a77a05 (AP)] [https://globalnation.inquirer.net/294928/madagascars-cornered-president-ignores-calls-to-resign (Global Nation)]

'''Business and economy'''
*[[2025 Nobel Prizes]]
**[[Joel Mokyr]] is awarded half of this year's [[Nobel Memorial Prize in Economic Sciences]] for "having identified the prerequisites for sustained growth through [[technological change|technological progress]]", with [[Philippe Aghion]] and [[Peter Howitt (economist)|Peter Howitt]] sharing the other half for "the theory of sustained growth through [[creative destruction]]". [https://edition.cnn.com/2025/10/13/business/nobel-prize-economics-winner-2025-intl (CNN)] [https://www.nobelprize.org/prizes/economic-sciences/2025/press-release/ (Nobel Prize)]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*At least 66 people are injured, including around 16 seriously, when two trains collide outside [[Jablonov nad Turňou]], [[Slovakia]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/least-20-injured-after-two-trains-slovakia-collide-2025-10-13/ (Reuters)]
*Two people are killed and one is injured when a [[SOCATA TBM-700]] aircraft crashes in [[Dartmouth, Massachusetts|Dartmouth]], [[Massachusetts]], [[United States]]. [https://apnews.com/article/massachusetts-plane-crash-dartmouth-0f852582f74f658c2cf01615c19d1b98 (AP News)]
*At least fourteen people are killed when a [[gold]] [[gold mining|mine]] collapses in [[El Callao]], [[Bolívar (state)|Bolívar]], [[Venezuela]]. The [[National Bolivarian Armed Forces of Venezuela|military]] sets up a command post to recover the bodies. [https://apnews.com/article/venezuela-gold-mine-collapse-deaths-bolivar-el-callao-782f5450f1e1e3697f63ec85972156b1 (AP)] [https://elpais.com/america/2025-10-14/al-menos-14-personas-fallecen-en-venezuela-al-inundarse-una-mina-de-oro.html (''El País'' <small>in Spanish</small>)]

'''Health and environment'''
*[[Tipping points in the climate system]], [[Environmental issues with coral reefs]] 
**Scientists at the [[University of Exeter]] in [[England]] report large-scale die-off of [[coral reef]]s, the first major tipping point in large changes in the [[climate system]]. [https://www.theguardian.com/environment/2025/oct/13/coral-reefs-ice-sheets-amazon-rainforest-tipping-point-global-heating-scientists-report (''The Guardian'')] [https://www.nature.com/articles/d41586-025-03316-w (''Nature'')]

'''International relations'''
*[[2025 Gaza peace summit]]
**[[Head of government|Heads of government]] of 30 countries and leaders of several major international organisations gather in [[Sharm El Sheikh]], [[Egypt]] to discuss the next steps in the implementation of the [[Gaza peace plan]]. It is expected that the focus will be on the future governance of the [[Gaza Strip]], security, and [[Gaza humanitarian crisis|humanitarian assistance]]. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/liveblog/2025/10/13/live-israel-hamas-set-to-free-captives-trump-says-gaza-war-is-over (Al Jazeera)] [https://www.theguardian.com/world/live/2025/oct/13/gaza-ceasefire-live-updates-israel-hostages-release-hamas-trump-middle-east (''The Guardian'')] [https://www.bbc.com/news/live/cx2r2z0gyp7t (BBC News)]
*[[China–Netherlands relations]]
**The [[Government of the Netherlands|Dutch government]] invokes the [[Goods Availability Act (Netherlands)|Goods Availability Act]] to seize control of the [[China|Chinese]]-owned [[semiconductor manufacturer]] [[Nexperia]], which is headquartered in [[Nijmegen]], [[Gelderland]], amid concerns that the company's governance "could pose a risk to Dutch and [[European Union|European]] [[economic security]]". [https://apnews.com/article/nexperia-wingtech-chips-netherlands-china-f1d3c84065cb61a1d645b64a3a2a68fc (AP)] [https://www.ft.com/content/605e5456-9437-47ff-be6a-edc5c82810f2 (''Financial Times'')]
*[[Pakistan–United States relations]]
**[[Prime Minister of Pakistan|Pakistani prime minister]] [[Shehbaz Sharif]] nominates [[President of the United States|United States president]] [[Donald Trump]] for the [[Nobel Peace Prize]] for a second time, citing his mediation of the [[Gaza peace plan]]. Sharif had previously nominated Trump in June for his role in mediating a ceasefire to the [[2025 India–Pakistan conflict]]. [https://thehill.com/policy/international/5553500-pakistani-pm-trump-nobel-peace-prize-gaza-egypt/ (''The Hill'')]

'''Law and crime'''
*Three faculty members are wounded in a [[stabbing attack]] at a private high school for neurodivergent children in [[Torrance, California|Torrance]], [[California]], United States. The suspected assailant, an ex-student, is arrested, and the two bombs he left nearby are found to be inactive. [https://www.msn.com/en-us/news/us/ex-student-stabs-3-staff-members-at-california-school/vi-AA1OohTh?ocid=msedgntp&pc=U531&cvid=68edb3a6d8664bd0b33dea598b4b64cf&ei=10 (MSN News)] [https://www.latimes.com/california/story/2025-10-13/torrance-school-stabbing (''Los Angeles Times'')]

'''Politics and elections'''
*[[2025 Nauruan parliamentary election]]
**Results from Saturday's election in [[Nauru]] show that incumbent [[President of Nauru|president]] [[David Adeang]] has been re-elected to his seat, though the [[Parliament of Nauru|parliament]] must decide whether Adeang will continue to serve as president. [https://www.rnz.co.nz/international/pacific-news/575731/nauru-election-results-voters-elect-new-mps-and-reject-4-year-term-proposal (RNZ)]
